hints.title: Parity Invariant
hints.text: For (sub[i] + sub[i + 1]) % 2 to be constant across the subsequence, the elements must either all share the same parity or alternate between even and odd.

hints.title: Four Candidates
hints.text: Check four candidate patterns: all even numbers, all odd numbers, alternating starting with even, and alternating starting with odd.

hints.title: Greedy Counts
hints.text: Count the maximum achievable length for each of the four configurations in a single linear pass.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass evaluating the four parity patterns.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Not applicable; single scan is already minimal.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Decompose the mod 2 parity requirement into 4 greedy patterns.
